eira.acquisition: Available at the start; also in Standard Summon.

skill_descriptions.basic: Automatically use damage skills when ready.
skill_descriptions.ultimate: Deal damage to multiple targets and heal yourself. Requires 100 Energy.

mira.acquisition: Clear campaign stage 2 or obtain from Standard Summon.

skill_descriptions.basic: Attack magic; switches to healing when an ally falls below 85% HP.
skill_descriptions.ultimate: Heal and shield surviving allies. Requires 100 Energy.

ryn.acquisition: Clear campaign stage 1 or obtain from Standard Summon.

skill_descriptions.basic: Ember Guard: strike and gain a shield equal to 8% max HP for 4s.
skill_descriptions.ultimate: Deal damage to multiple targets and heal yourself; also gain a shield. Requires 100 Energy.

lyra.acquisition: Clear campaign stage 3 or obtain from Standard Summon.

skill_descriptions.basic: Flare Thrust: damage skill every 4.3s. Direct hits deal 35% extra damage to foes below 30% HP.
skill_descriptions.ultimate: Twilight Comet: strike the lowest-health enemy for 440% skill-scaled ATK. Requires 100 Energy. No self-heal.

caelan.acquisition: Clear Forest Entrance, then recruit Caelan for free in Gallery.

skill_descriptions.basic: Shield Line: strike for 125% skill-scaled ATK and shield the lowest-HP living ally for 14% of their max HP for 5s.
skill_descriptions.ultimate: Unbroken Dawn: shield each living ally for 22% of their max HP for 6s. Requires 100 Energy.

caelan.fragment_source: Earn 2 Caelan Fragments per Dawn Triad victory with Caelan in your squad.
